title: Drawing from the Window
transcript: I bought a notebook to draw in during a holiday, but I brought it home empty. After that, I decided to try drawing something I could see from my kitchen window every morning. I started with the tree across the street. At first, I paid attention only to its shape. Over several weeks, I began to notice how differently the leaves looked before and after rain. My drawings are still simple, but I look at familiar things more carefully now.

questions.prompt: What did the speaker draw first?
options: A view from a hotel window.
questions.explanation: 最先画厨房窗外街对面的树。

questions.prompt: How has drawing affected the speaker?
options: The speaker pays closer attention to everyday sights.
The speaker prefers drawing indoors at night.
questions.answer: The speaker pays closer attention to everyday sights.
questions.explanation: 结尾说现在会更细致地观察熟悉的事物。
